He has even been known to steal souls from Slaanesh, using his cunning and intellect to win their freedom from an eternity of torment.

technology_short_description: Wisest of all who dwell in the forest of Athel Loren, the Ancients have forgotten more than most Elves learn in a lifetime.
technology_long_description: Older than the forest itself, the Ancients of Athel Loren are to be revered and feared. The Cytharai, on the other hand, are the Gods of the Underworld, or Mirai, and are often appeased rather than worshipped. As the Elves of Athel Loren are free to worship as they choose, their are those who take the Cytharai to heart; rumours say that the warriors of the Pine Crags have forsaken Kurnous for his vengeful counterpart, Anaeth Raema.
